name: canship
description: Pre-deployment security checks for JavaScript and TypeScript web apps: exposed credentials, missing access controls and unsafe request input. Runs locally.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Scanning local files and Git history requires a trusted workspace. No project dependencies are executed.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The scanner requires local filesystem and optional Git access.

canship.scanOnSave.description: Scan after saves. Disabled by default; reads saved files, not unsaved buffers.

canship.includeLikely.description: Include likely findings. Hidden findings still count in the summary.

canship.useProjectConfig.description: Read the selected folder's Canship config and configured baseline.

canship.honorIgnoreMarkers.description: Honor source suppression comments. Disable when scanning untrusted source within a trusted workspace.

canship.saveDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before a save-triggered scan.
